out.rationale: Khan et al. report debate beats consultancy and naive (no-article) judging on QuALITY; the authors explicitly say these results generalise to further extractive tasks and, for debate vs consultancy, to closed tasks. out.scope: proposed SUPPORTS: Judge accuracy of debate vs consultancy and vs QA without article, for judges weaker than or equal to the debaters

text: The authors report that the results of Khan et al. on QuALITY generalise to other extractive tasks with different models: judges are more accurate with debate than with consultancy and QA without article, except the weakest judge (Gemma7B). They also see debate beat consultancy on closed tasks, previously only seen on QuALITY.
title: Kenton et al. find Khan et al.'s debate-over-consultancy QuALITY result generalises to other tasks
